ACTION 28 OF 32 · PHASE 07

Use organizations and speaking to open doors

Find credible introductions, mentorship, programmes and speaking practice.

WHEN TO DO THISOnce you can articulate an actual offer or ask.ESTIMATED WORK TIME60 min to shortlist; ongoing relationship building
↗
Your one job

Find credible introductions, mentorship, programmes and speaking practice.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Check Bahamas Chamber of Commerce and Employers' Confederation events, membership and potential business introductions.

  2. 02

    Explore SBDC Bahamas advisory, mentorship and access-to-capital support; check current requirements.

  3. 03

    Find a Toastmasters club for presentation practice and relationship-building—it's not a grant provider.

  4. 04

    Attend with a one-sentence offer and one specific request for an introduction, mentor or partner.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Create a practical networking plan for [BUSINESS] in The Bahamas using the Bahamas Chamber, SBDC Bahamas, Toastmasters and relevant industry associations. Explain what each organization actually offers, eligibility/costs to verify, my reason to approach them, a 30-second introduction and one specific ask. Include official URLs and do not claim they will fund me or make introductions.
03

Finish with this

An organization outreach plan with dates, eligibility and specific asks.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Organizations have official links
  • Ask is specific and relevant
  • Speaking/mentorship distinguished from funding
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Joining every membership group without knowing what outcome you need.
